welcome.greeting:
Hello{{name}}, and welcome to Assur'Assistance. 👋

I can prepare a travel insurance quote for you in just a few questions.
welcome.menu: What would you like to do?
welcome.languageHint: At any time, write FRANCAIS to continue in French.
welcome.resumePrompt: We had already started a quote for you. Would you like to pick up where we left off?

personalInfo.prompt:
To begin, send me in a single message:

*Last name*, *First name*, *Date of birth*

For example: Ali, Saif, 12/03/1990
personalInfo.promptSimple: Let's do this more simply, one question at a time.

nationality.prompt: What is your *nationality*? Write the country name.
nationality.candidates: Several countries match. Which one is right?
nationality.notFound: I could not find that country. Try writing the full name, or choose from the list.

passport.prompt: What is your *passport number* (or ID number)?

destination.prompt: Where are you *travelling to*? Write the country name.
destination.candidates: Several destinations match. Which one is right?
destination.notFound: I could not find that destination. Try again, or choose from the list.

travelDates.prompt:
What are your *travel dates*?

Send departure and return, for example: 01/10/2026, 15/10/2026

email.prompt: What is your *email address*? We will send your certificate there.

phone.prompt: We will use this WhatsApp number ({{number}}) as your contact number. Is that correct?
phone.otherPrompt: Send the number to use, including the country code. For example: +225 07 18 92 31 94

plan.prompt: Here are the plans available for your trip:
plan.none: No plan is available for this combination of destination and duration. An agent will contact you.

review.title: Thank you. Here is a summary of your details:
review.question: Is everything correct?
review.editPrompt: Which detail would you like to correct?

quote.title: 🛡️ *Your quote {{reference}}*
quote.question: Would you like to confirm this quote?
quote.confirmed:
✅ Perfect. Your quote *{{reference}}* has been saved.

An agent will contact you to complete payment, and your certificate will then be emailed to you.
quote.cancelled: Your request has been cancelled. Write *RESTART* at any time to start a new quote.
quote.ineligible: Given the age of the insured, this quote requires a specific exemption. An agent will contact you.
quote.noPrice: I cannot calculate a premium for this combination. An agent will contact you.

error.required: I need this detail to continue. Could you send it again?
error.name_too_short: That name looks too short. Could you send it in full?
error.name_too_long: That name is too long. Could you shorten it?
error.name_has_digits: A name does not contain numbers. Could you send it again?
error.name_invalid: That name contains characters that are not allowed. Could you send it again?
error.passport_too_short: That number looks too short. Could you check it?
error.passport_too_long: That number looks too long. Could you check it?
error.passport_invalid: Use letters and numbers only, with no special characters.
error.passport_no_digit: A passport number normally contains at least one digit. Could you check it?
error.email_invalid: That email address does not look valid. Could you send it again?
error.email_too_long: That email address is too long.
error.phone_invalid: That number does not look valid. Use digits only, including the country code.
error.phone_no_country_code: Please include the country code, for example +225…
error.dob_unparseable: I did not understand that date. Please write it as DD/MM/YYYY, for example 12/03/1990.
error.dob_future: A date of birth cannot be in the future. Could you check it?
error.dob_implausible: That year of birth looks unusual. Could you check it?
error.date_unparseable: I did not understand that date. Please write it as DD/MM/YYYY.
error.dates_out_of_order: The return date must be after the departure date.
error.dates_too_long: Cover is available for up to 365 days.
error.start_in_past: The departure date cannot be in the past.
error.gender_invalid: Please choose Male, Female or Other.
error.grouped_ambiguous: To avoid a mistake, separate the details with commas: Last name, First name, Date of birth.
error.grouped_incomplete: One detail is missing. Please send all three: Last name, First name, Date of birth.
error.generic: I did not understand. Could you rephrase?
error.tooManyRetries: I am having trouble recording this detail. Let's try a simpler way.

session.expired: Our previous conversation has expired. Write *HELLO* to start a new quote.
session.expiredResume: Our previous conversation expired, but I kept your details. Would you like to resume?
session.noPrevious: We are at the start, so there is nothing before this question.

help.text:
Here is what you can write at any time:

*RESTART* — start again from the beginning
*BACK* — go back to the previous question
*HELP* — show this message
*AGENT* — be put in touch with a person
*FRANCAIS* — continuer en français

agent.requested: Noted. An agent will take over as soon as possible.
agent.withNumber: Noted. You can also reach an agent directly on {{number}}.
agent.resume: In the meantime we can carry on. Write *RESTART* if you would rather begin again.

language.switched: Great, I will continue in English. 🇬🇧

unsupported.image: I cannot read images. Could you type your answer instead?
unsupported.audio: I cannot listen to voice notes. Could you type your answer instead?
unsupported.video: I cannot watch videos. Could you type your answer instead?
unsupported.document: I cannot open documents here. Could you type your answer instead?
unsupported.location: Thank you, but I cannot use a location. Could you write the country name?
unsupported.generic: I can only handle text and the buttons I offer. Could you type your answer?
unsupported.emptyMessage: I did not receive anything. Could you send your answer again?
unsupported.tooLong: That message is very long. Could you answer more briefly?

system.unavailable: The quote service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
system.error: A technical error occurred on our side. We are fixing it; please try again in a few minutes.
